_notes: Gold set for the RAG retrieval eval (tests/eval/test_rag_eval.py).
Positive entries map a realistic user question to the (source file, section heading)
pairs whose chunk(s) genuinely answer it. A section of '*' accepts any section from
that source. Sections are the exact '## ' heading text in backend/data/knowledge/.
Negative entries probe the two-tier distance floor: 'negative_far' is far-domain junk
the floor must catch; 'negative_near' is near-domain (wrong game / unanswerable detail)
that measurably scores CLOSER than some legitimate hits and can only be handled by the
prompt — kept here so that limitation stays measured, not forgotten.
The first four questions are the MetaTab example chips, verbatim.
Going forward: add 2-3 questions per ingested patch (see the patch-13.05 block at the end).
